text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day that Special Week and I
agreed upon to do some
training outside
the academy. Or, well,
that was the plan...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? D-do I? But I feel fine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-all righty! Let's keep giving it our all
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suspect that something is up with
Special
Week, but I let it go for
the time being to
focus on her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew! ♪ Another day, another great
training session! I feel like I
could go for
another round of running, though!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I have an idea! Trainer, how about I
run on my way back? It'll be
like extra
train—

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Mommy! I want a croquette! I want it!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
If you eat now, you won't have any space
for dinner! We're going
home, dear.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, it's nothing! It just reminded me
of my own mom, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I also used to bug her for things and get
scolded for it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! But...
she's so far away. I
can't just meet her on a whim.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We did actually talk on the phone
yesterday, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She told me about our neighbor's cow and
how it gave birth to a new calf recently.
She also talked about our carrots and how
they're all
growing really big.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We talked a lot, and well... It made me
miss home, so I told her I
missed her carrot
stew.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She asked me if I was feeling down and
if I
was okay. She told me not
to push myself
too hard. She sounded really worried.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to make Mom and Mama proud, but
all I do is cause worry...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Sigh... If only she were here now...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then I'd be able to tell her in person—
that
it's a bit lonely, but I'm
still doing my best.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh... S-silly me.
I shouldn't talk about this
with you. I don't want to
cause you any
more trouble than I already have.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's hurry up and go back to the
academy! Wait, what's
that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Over there...
at the bookstore! Suzuka's on
the front page of that
magazine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to take a detour and stop by
the bookstore to pick up a
copy of the
magazine in question.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Isn't this magazine super famous?!
I've even seen it back at
home in
Hokkaido!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's incredible,
isn't she? She's always
running in one race or
another.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I need to stop moping around and
work hard enough to be on
the cover of
magazines.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? What would? Oh wait, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I make to the front page of a magazine,
I'd be able to show my
mom that I'm doing
fine all on my own.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sure that'd make her happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There might not be vast pastures here for
me to run through, and my
favorite carrot
fields might be missing, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll still try my hardest!
I'll do whatever it
takes to become the best
version of
myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week solemnly gazes into the
evening sky. Her complexion is one of
sadness, but her eyes tell a different
story—the girl is nothing
if not determined.
